signature.title: From supplier data to trusted product intelligence.
signature.subtitle: A rigorous architectural chain that turns scattered declarations into legally defensible product knowledge.
signature.step1Desc: Collaborative multi-tier portal for Tier 1 to Tier 4 partners with proprietary trade secret guarantees.
signature.step2Desc: Standardized form schemas for fiber compositions, facility coordinates, chemical compliance and PEF footprints.
signature.step3Desc: Cryptographically linked transaction certificates (GOTS, GRS, SMETA, OEKO-TEX) with automated OCR validation.
signature.step4Desc: Explainable 6-level grading matrix from self-declared claims to certified third-party auditable facts.
signature.step5Desc: Continuous mass-balance reconciliation across every transformation stage to eradicate greenwashing risks.
signature.step6Desc: One-click European Digital Product Passport generation conforming to CIRPASS and ESPR standards.

problem.title:
Your supply chain already has the data.
It just isn't connected.
problem.subtitle: Fashion brands don't lack supplier documents. They lack the technological infrastructure to verify, structure and query them at the product and lot level.
problem.silosSub: Unsearchable files scattered across departments and inboxes:
problem.silosResult: Result: Expired certificates, unverified claims, blind compliance liability.
problem.unifiedSub: Structured, queryable data models linked directly to SKUs:
problem.unifiedResult: Result: Defensible CSRD reporting, automated audits, consumer trust.

supply.title: See your supply chain as data.
supply.subtitle: Trace transformation flows from agricultural origin to retail shelf with auditable mass-balance reconciliation. Click any node to inspect live credentials.

product.title: Product Intelligence at SKU Precision
product.subtitle: TRACEFAB aggregates compositions, facility certifications, chemical reports, and custody logs into an authoritative product specification record.

supplierSection.title:
One supplier profile.
Reusable across products and brands.
supplierSection.subtitle: The biggest friction in textile traceability is supplier fatigue from repetitive questionnaire requests. TRACEFAB allows manufacturers to build a permanent, encrypted evidence vault.
supplierSection.innovationSub: Enter data once → reuse with authorized brands
supplierSection.innovationDesc: Suppliers upload audits (GOTS, SMETA, ISO) once and grant instant access to selected brand clients in one click.
supplierSection.tradeSecretDesc: Suppliers maintain 100% confidentiality over costs, margins, and proprietary recipes. Only certified compliance output is audited.

qualitySection.title: Know what you can trust.
qualitySection.subtitle: No arbitrary 5-star ratings or opaque green badges. TRACEFAB grades every datapoint according to explicit, legally defensible tiers of evidence.
qualitySection.indexSub: High Trust Level · 100% Core Requirements Documented

dppSection.title:
Don't wait for the passport.
Build the data behind it.
dppSection.subtitle: The EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) is a data challenge, not a QR code challenge. Without auditable multi-tier provenance, public passports cannot be legally published.
dppSection.disclaimer: Note: DPP Readiness reflects internal data completeness and does not constitute regulatory compliance certification.
